    Given the system requires a valid login id and password
    When a user enters incorrect login id and password
    Then the user should be denied access to the System

    When the Administrator adds a new user

  Scenario: Administrator Manages User Accounts - Setup Users/Passwords

    When the Administrator sets up new user credentials
    Then the credentials should be securely stored

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu

    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality section
    Then the Maintain Speciality section should be accessible

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Speciality
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality section
    Then the Maintain Speciality section should be accessible

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Speciality
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator adds a new speciality
    Then the new speciality should be listed with its details

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Add Speciality
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator adds a new speciality
    And the Administrator provides a valid Speciality Id, Name, and Description
    Then the new speciality should be created and listed with its details

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Edit/Update Speciality

    When the Administrator navigates to the Edit/Update Speciality section
    And the Administrator selects a speciality to modify
    Then the speciality's details should be displayed for editing

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Edit/Update Speciality - Valid Input
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    And the Administrator is viewing a speciality to modify
    When the Administrator enters valid Speciality Id, Name, and Description
    Then the details should update correctly

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Edit/Update Speciality - Invalid Input
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    And the Administrator is viewing a speciality to modify
    When the Administrator enters invalid Speciality Id, Name, or Description
    Then the system should display an error and prompt for correct information

    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    And the Administrator is viewing a speciality to modify
    When the Administrator enters boundary values for Speciality Id, Name, or Description
    Then the system should handle these values correctly

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Edit/Update Speciality - Negative/Error Paths
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    And the Administrator is viewing a speciality to modify
    When the Administrator attempts to use negative or erroneous input
    Then the system should display appropriate error messages and prompt for correct information

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Backups and Archive
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator navigates to the Backups and Archive section
    Then the system should list available backups and archive options

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - View/Print Invoice
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator navigates to the View/Print Invoice section
    Then the system should display the invoice details

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Backups and Archive - Positive Path
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator selects a backup or archive option
    Then the system should process the request correctly

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Backups and Archive - Negative/Error Paths
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator selects a backup or archive option
    When the selected option is invalid or results in an error
    Then the system should display an appropriate error message

  Scenario: Administrator Accesses Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Backups and Archive - Boundary Values
    Given the Administrator is responsible for maintaining user accounts
    When the Administrator selects a backup or archive option
    When the system is at its backup or archive limit
    Then the system should handle this boundary condition correctly

    When the selected option attempts to process beyond the system' extraneous data
